AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: DJ Mini plays music files saved on this device. playSong plays one song that matches a title, an artist, or an album, and then keeps playing songs that sound like it. playAlbum plays every song of one album in track order. Constraints: - Only music files saved on this device can be played; streaming services are not available. - playSong starts one song; after it, DJ Mini picks each next song at random from the three songs that sound most like the song before, and never plays a song twice until the next call. - playAlbum stops after the last song of the album; it does not go on to other songs.
